people.name: Omri
people.line: King of Israel; father of Ahab

translations.web: Omri did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and dealt wickedly above all who were before him.
translations.bsb: But Omri did evil in the sight of the LORD and acted more wickedly than all who were before him.
translations.kjv: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the LORD, and did worse than all that were before him.
translations.asv: And Omri did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and dealt wickedly above all that were before him.
